name: Raven Hill
summary: Reports of shifting shadows and flickering window light in the abandoned settlement of Raven Hill have set the Night Watch on edge. Dispatched by Elaine Carevin in Darkshire, travelers are sent west across the haunted woods to confront whatever sinister presence has taken shelter among the ruins.

sections.title: Eyes in the West
sections.body: To the rangers of the Night Watch, the far western edge of Duskwood has long been surrendered to the dead and the wilderness. Yet complete abandonment would be preferable to unexpected activity. Calor, a watcher patrolling the gloomy roads, noticed movement among the silent houses of Raven Hill two nights in a row, punctuated by the unsettling flicker of a lantern in a window. In a land plagued by ghouls, skeletons, and beasts, any unexplained signs of life demand immediate investigation.

sections.title: A Rattled Hermit
sections.body: Those expecting to clash with an emergent demon or undead warlord inside Raven Hill find a far more pathetic reality. Huddled in terror amid the dilapidated ruins is Jitters, a thoroughly unhinged vagabond trembling at every rustle in the dark. While he frantically protests that there is no threat besides 'harmless Jitters,' his manic rambling suggests that he knows far more about the nightmare consuming Duskwood than he dares to say.

faq.q: Who sends you to investigate Raven Hill?
faq.answer: Elaine Carevin, a resident in Darkshire who assists the Night Watch, asks travelers who care about Duskwood's safety to check out the disturbing sightings reported from the west.

faq.q: What did Calor actually see in Raven Hill?
faq.answer: Calor reported seeing moving shadows in the abandoned settlement two nights in a row, as well as a lantern or candle burning in one of the building windows the night before that.

faq.q: What monster is haunting the ruins?
faq.answer: That is exactly what you are sent to discover. Calor has only glimpsed moving shadows and a light in a window; whatever lurks in the derelict buildings of Raven Hill must be found in person.

Jitters is a jumpy, paranoid vagrant living on the edge of terror in western Duskwood. While he claims to be completely harmless, his extreme guilt and frantic ramblings hint that he is tangled up in the region's darker mysteries.
Raven Hill lies in the far western section of Duskwood, situated just south of the massive, undead-infested cemetery that shares its name.

faq.q: Why is the Night Watch so concerned about moving shadows?
faq.answer: Darkshire is stretched thin against skeletal uprisings, feral worgen, and lurking spiders. Any sign of organized movement or strange inhabitants in the abandoned west could signal an impending assault on the remaining living settlements.

angles.text: The Night Watch of Duskwood receives little to no aid from Stormwind's garrison, forcing them to rely on traveling Alliance heroes to investigate ominous threats in the ruined corners of the territory.

Trained to hunt the restless undead that plague the neighboring cemetery, a paladin investigating reports of sinister haunting may find the whimpering, flesh-and-blood Jitters to be an unexpected discovery.
